summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K responding to a Korea Exchange disclosure inquiry dated August 21, 2026, concerning media reports that the company is considering building a semiconductor facility in Japan. The company confirmed it is reviewing various measures, including additional production bases, to strengthen memory-business competitiveness, but stated no matters have been determined. It will disclose further when details are confirmed or within three months. This is a routine rumor-response clarification, not a special situation; no transaction, counterparty, price, or ownership terms are stated. Watch for follow-up disclosure on any Japan fab decision.
